name: Bulgarian split squat

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Drop your back knee straight down

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Tall chest, weight on the front foot

formTips: Rest the top of your back foot on a knee-high bench behind you
Step the front foot far enough forward that the knee stays over the foot at the bottom
Keep most of your weight on the front foot
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about level
Push up through the whole front foot; do all reps, then switch legs
commonMistakes: Standing too close to the bench, so the front heel lifts
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front
